observation.visible_scene: Top-down view of a wooden floor holding a starburst arrangement of dominoes: eight colored radial arms (yellow, green, light blue, navy, purple, magenta/pink, red, orange) each joined to a central yellow disc (topped by a small red piece) by a short arc of black dominoes. A vertical line of black dominoes runs from the center down to a horizontal black domino line that crosses the bottom of the frame.
visible_changes: From t=0 to about t=0.96 s the whole layout is static; all arms and the black connectors stand upright.
Around t=1.00–1.20 s the black connector dominoes ringing the center begin tipping inward/outward, and the central red piece on the yellow disc starts to tilt and lie down.

From about t=1.20 s to the end (t=1.60 s) the collapse propagates outward along each colored arm: the inner ends of the yellow, green, blue, navy, purple, pink, red and orange rows fall first, with the fallen front moving toward the outer tips.
By the last frame the inner portions of all eight arms are down while the outer ends of the arms are still standing, so the radial collapse is still in progress and not completed.
The vertical black line from the center and the horizontal black line at the bottom remain upright and unchanged throughout the excerpt.
The arms do not translate; the change is each domino tipping in place (deformation/collapse), and the floor framing stays essentially fixed, indicating no noticeable camera motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: What initiated the fall of the central black connectors (no trigger is visible; the segment opens on a static scene).
Whether the still-standing outer arm segments, the vertical line, or the bottom horizontal line eventually fall after t=1.60 s.
The final resting state of the central red piece and disc.
uncertain_details: Exact frame at which the central red piece fully tips versus merely tilts.
Precise ordering/speed of the collapse between individual arms (they fall nearly simultaneously outward from the center).
Any very slight camera drift is not clearly distinguishable from the static background.
